summary: Dify publishes no quantitative results about its own performance: the README, docs/ and the package CHANGELOG contain no accuracy, latency, throughput or cost figures. It ships three runnable harnesses with no committed output: a Locust SSE stress test of POST /v1/workflows/run against a mock OpenAI server (whose README says the workload 'does not establish real-model latency or a universal production capacity threshold'), Go end-to-end benchmarks for the dify-agent-runtime shellctl API, and an OceanBase vector-store insertion/search benchmark.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
